subject: RECORD clause
notes: Landed by kb/Work PB1276 (w61f). cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 'Integer-1 specifies the number of bytes contained in each record in the file' -> OK §13.18.43.4 6). FileModel.RecordWidth - the ONE record-area size every connector registration, the SORT/MERGE record length and the fixed-file attributes read - is max(integer-1, the descriptions' physical width), so integer-1 sizes an FD and an SD whose descriptions are smaller (§13.18.43.3 SR3 permits them). Golden 85/pb1276_record_contains_sizes_file: two WRITEs of a 10-byte R1 under RECORD CONTAINS 20 read back through a 20-byte FD as TWO records (was one 20-byte record), and SORT through an SD RECORD CONTAINS 20 over a 10-byte description keeps each 20-byte USING record whole (was cut to 10).
